caseNameFull: DUTTON Et Al. v. TAWES, GOVERNOR OF MARYLAND
attorneys: Hyman A. Pressman for appellants., Thomas B. Finan, Attorney General of Maryland, and Joseph S. Kaufman, Deputy Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
